steps.name: a real project opens through the catalog
the real composer is on screen
plain Enter inserts a newline instead of sending
the draft is in place before the shortcut
Ctrl+Enter does not insert a newline
Ctrl+Enter did not send anything without a connected runtime
an IME composition Enter is not consumed as a send
a held Ctrl+Enter is still one shortcut, not several

limitation: Physical IME composition is a human check: Chromium cannot be driven into composing state from the main process. Ctrl+Enter and plain Enter were pressed through Electron sendInputEvent in a real window.
